# KopaBook

> KopaBook is the free sales, stock and debt record book for businesses everywhere.
> Track sales, expenses, inventory and customer debts from your phone.

- Website: https://kopabook.com/
- Maker: FVA70K Services (https://fva70k.com)
- Contact: info@kopabook.com

## What it is

KopaBook is a simple, free record keeper for local businesses everywhere.
Shops, hotels, restaurants, salons, pharmacies, artisans. If you sell
something, KopaBook keeps your books straight.

KopaBook replaces the paper notebook with one simple app on your phone.
Record sales in seconds, watch your stock move, and always know who owes
you. Free to start, works on any phone.

KopaBook is a record keeper, not a payment processor. It never touches
your money. Every payment in the app is a record of money that changed
hands outside it, through cash, bank transfer, or POS. There is no
gateway, no wallet, no card charging. Your money stays yours.

KopaBook is built to be usable worldwide. You set your country, currency,
and timezone at signup, and money shows in your own currency with dates
in your own timezone.

## Features

- Sales recording: a sale in under 5 taps. Stock deducts the moment you
  save, and partial payments automatically become debts.
- Products and stock: products and services with units like piece, kg or
  litre, a stock ledger for every movement, and low-stock alerts.
- Customers and debts: a running debt ledger per customer. Customers can
  pay bit by bit, and overpayments come back as change, never negative debt.
- Expenses: log daily expenses by category in seconds.
- Receipts: share a receipt with any customer on WhatsApp, or download,
  save and copy it as a PNG image. Printable formats for 58mm and 80mm
  thermal printers.
- Notebook: shared notes the whole team sees, plus private notes only
  you see, written like real book pages.
- Messages: broadcast promos and new products to customers on WhatsApp,
  and send quick notes to staff.
- Staff and roles: partner, manager, accountant, cashier, storekeeper,
  attendant and hotel roles. Each role sees only its own workspace.
- Many businesses, one account: own several businesses and switch between
  them instantly. Each keeps its own staff, sales, stock and records,
  completely separate.
- Suppliers: supplier records linked to your stock.
- Calculator: quick business math with history and memory, inside the app.
- Activity log: an audit trail of important actions across your business.
- Website chatbot and Chat Center: your business gets its own chatbot
  that answers customers on your connected website.
- Ask Kopa AI: your business assistant in chat. Ask about your sales,
  stock and debts in plain words.
- Shipments: generate a tracking number when a sold product ships, and
  move it from pending to shipped to delivered.
- Hotel module: rooms, bookings, guest folios, extra charges and payments,
  built for hotels, guest houses and lodges.
- WhatsApp debt reminders: polite debt reminders straight to WhatsApp,
  drafted from each customer's real balance.
- Full reports: profit trend, best sellers, slow movers, payment breakdown
  and date-range summaries, with one-tap CSV export.
- CSV import: import marketplace sales reports from CSV files.
- Projects: full accountability for any project. Record every income and
  expense, track milestones, then generate a complete report showing
  exactly where every naira went.

## Pricing

- Free: NGN 0, free forever. 1 business, 1 staff. Sales, stock and debts,
  free forever. 100 sales per week per business, 100 products and services
  per business. Recording a sale is always free and never blocked, on any
  plan.
- Starter: NGN 1,000 per month, or NGN 10,000 per year. 5 businesses,
  5 staff accounts, WhatsApp debt reminders, full reports with CSV export,
  CSV import.
- Solo: NGN 5,000 per month, or NGN 50,000 per year. 1 business, 3 staff
  accounts, everything in Starter, plus shipment tracking and hotel
  operations.
- Pro: NGN 10,000 per month, or NGN 100,000 per year. Unlimited businesses,
  unlimited sales, products and staff accounts, everything in Solo.

Paid subscriptions are billed in Nigerian naira through Paystack.

## Getting started

Register your business in minutes: name, business type, country,
currency, and timezone. Add your products, invite your staff, and record
your first sale: https://kopabook.com/register
